delete.description: Keeps the workspaces and returns the deleted section with all workspace IDs that were unfiled. The deletion snapshot is returned once; a missing or already deleted section returns 404. The Pinned section can't be deleted.

get.description: Returns the shared port and its preview URL, or `preview: null` when no port is shared.

put.summary: Share a workspace port at its preview URL.
put.description: Each workspace has at most one preview URL; setting a different port keeps the URL and points it at the new port. Something must be listening on that port inside the workspace (for example `python3 -m http.server <port> --bind 127.0.0.1`). Viewers sign in with Conductor and need read access to the workspace. The URL stops serving while the workspace sleeps and is deleted when the workspace is archived.

delete.summary: Stop sharing a workspace's preview URL.
delete.description: Idempotent. Setting a preview again afterwards reuses the workspace's preview URL.

post.description: Creates a cloud workspace and first session, optionally queues its initial message, and returns a deep link that opens the workspace in the Conductor desktop app. When a message is included, the response's initialMessage contains its ID and whether it was sent or queued; if the message could not be accepted, the workspace and session are still created and initialMessage is omitted — resend it via the messages endpoint. Creation is not idempotent: retrying a request whose response was lost creates another workspace. Pass either projectId or repositoryUrl. With an organization API key, the workspace launches on the organization's machine; the machine must include the repository. Omit agent and model to use the caller's default model as saved in the Conductor app (the first favorite in the model picker), including its effort and fastMode unless those are sent explicitly. When no default is saved, or its agent has no connected credentials, the agent defaults to codex and the model to the agent's default — claude: opus-5-1m; codex: gpt-6.1-sol; cursor: composer-2.5. Accepted model ids by agent — claude: fable-5-1, fable-5, opus-5-5-1m, opus-5-1m, opus-4-8-1m, opus-4-8, opus-4-7-1m, opus-4-7, opus-4-6-1m, sonnet-5-5-1m, sonnet-5-1m, sonnet-4-6-1m, sonnet-4-6, haiku-4-5; codex: gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.3-codex-spark, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-daybreak-blue-latest; cursor: auto, composer-2.5, grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5. Accepted effort levels by agent — claude: low, medium, high, xhigh, max; codex: none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra; cursor: low, medium, high, xhigh; codex max and ultra require support from the selected model. Omit effort to use the agent's default — claude: high; codex: high. Models accepting fastMode by agent — claude: opus-5-5-1m, opus-5-1m, opus-4-8-1m, opus-4-8, opus-4-7-1m, opus-4-7, opus-4-6-1m; codex: gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.3-codex-spark, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-daybreak-blue-latest; cursor: auto, composer-2.5, grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5. Omit fastMode (or send false) for other models.

post.summary: Run a read-only SQL query over session transcripts.
post.description:
Runs a single read-only SQL SELECT statement over session transcripts and returns the matching rows. The view covers only the workspaces in your organization that you can access: those shared with the whole organization plus any private workspaces shared with you.

Queries may ONLY read from the view session_transcripts_view; every other table, view, and function is off-limits. Query it like a table, e.g. SELECT ... FROM session_transcripts_view. Its columns are:

- session_id (text): ID of the session (chat).
- workspace_id (text): ID of the workspace the session belongs to.
- transcript (text): concise plain-text transcript of the session's conversation.
- session_title (text, nullable): title of the session.
- agent_type (text, nullable): agent that ran the session, e.g. 'claude' or 'codex'.
- model (text, nullable): model the session used.
- workspace_name (text, nullable): display name of the workspace.
- workspace_state (text): workspace lifecycle state, e.g. 'ready' or 'archived'.
- repo_url (text): git remote URL of the workspace's repository.
- session_created_at (timestamptz): when the session was created.
- transcript_updated_at (timestamptz): when the transcript last changed.
- workspace_created_at (timestamptz): when the workspace was created.
- workspace_creator_id (text, nullable): ID of the user who created the workspace; matches the user id from GET /me for scoping "my" queries.
- workspace_creator_name (text, nullable): display name of the workspace creator (their email when no name is set).

Limits: at most 500 rows are returned (the response sets truncated: true when the query matched more), statements time out after 5 seconds, and the query text may be at most 10000 characters. The statement must be a single query: semicolon-chained statements, writes, U& Unicode-escape syntax, and queries containing the text set_config anywhere (even inside a search string) are rejected. Errors come back as 400s carrying the Postgres error message.

Example queries:

- Search transcripts: SELECT session_id, session_title, workspace_name FROM session_transcripts_view WHERE transcript ILIKE '%database migration%' ORDER BY transcript_updated_at DESC LIMIT 20
- Recent sessions in live workspaces: SELECT session_title, workspace_name, transcript_updated_at FROM session_transcripts_view WHERE workspace_state = 'ready' ORDER BY transcript_updated_at DESC LIMIT 50

Creates a routine with a single webhook trigger in the given projectId. POSTing JSON to the returned webhookUrl runs the routine's prompt in a new workspace as the routine owner, using the owner's credentials for the selected agent. The webhookUrl is the trigger's only credential and is returned here and from rotate-secret only; treat it as a secret. Requires a user API key: workspace API keys and other sign-in credentials receive 403. The routine is owned by the key's user in the key's organization. Accepted model ids by agent — claude: fable-5-1, fable-5, opus-5-5-1m, opus-5-1m, opus-4-8-1m, opus-4-8, opus-4-7-1m, opus-4-7, opus-4-6-1m, sonnet-5-5-1m, sonnet-5-1m, sonnet-4-6-1m, sonnet-4-6, haiku-4-5; codex: gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.3-codex-spark, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-daybreak-blue-latest; cursor: auto, composer-2.5, grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5. Accepted effort levels by agent — claude: low, medium, high, xhigh, max; codex: none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra; cursor: low, medium, high, xhigh; codex max and ultra require support from the selected model. Omit effort to use the agent's default — claude: high; codex: high.

get.description: Lists the routines owned by the key's user, newest first. Trigger metadata never includes the webhook URL or secret. Requires a user API key: workspace API keys and other sign-in credentials receive 403. The routine is owned by the key's user in the key's organization.

post.description: Replaces the webhook secret of the routine's single webhook trigger and returns the routine with the new webhookUrl. The previous URL stops working immediately. Only the routine's owner may rotate it; other routines are reported as not found. Requires a user API key: workspace API keys and other sign-in credentials receive 403. The routine is owned by the key's user in the key's organization.

get.description: Returns the model configurations the key's user saved as favorites in the Conductor app for the key's organization, in picker order. Available only in cloud organizations; local organizations keep favorite models on each Mac. When `agent` and `model` are omitted, create-workspace uses the first entry if it names a public agent and model and that agent has credentials. Entries can name agents or models the public API doesn't accept.
